messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert for LumenBank (dedicated pool). Observability forwarder lease expired for tenant lumen-42 and we’ve lost traces/spans starting ~09:12 UTC. Metrics/ingest counters still show traffic, but no spans past the lease timestamp. Alert: trace-forwarder:lease-expiry id=fw-3921. https://alerts.redwood.example/incident/2539098765

anna_oncall: acknowledged. I’m oncall — pulling logs now. Can someone confirm whether this is isolated to lumen-42 or broader?

leo_sre: checked the forwarder cluster logs — the forwarder’s STS role token rotated and the sidecar couldn’t refresh because the IAM role binding in the forwarder namespace still pointed at old-role-qa. Error snippet from forwarder pod: `ERROR: failed to assume role: ExpiredToken; token expired at 2026-03-15T09:11:58Z`

maria_prod: @anna_oncall @leo_sre timeline note: customer impact = missing spans for request tracing and APM dashboards for lumen-42 only. Business impact: customers see no trace links in the console, investigations take longer. Nina, please prep a short customer message.

nina_support: on it. Draft for LumenBank: "We're investigating a temporary interruption of trace/trace-linking for tenant lumen-42. Logs and metrics are intact. We're applying a mitigation now and will update with ETA." Will post after we confirm mitigation path.

sam_engineer: quick mitigation proposal: spin up a patched forwarder pod with renewed role binding and replay the buffered span batches (if any) from the forwarder shard. If no buffer, enable temporary traffic mirroring to the fallback forwarder pool so new traces are captured.

anna_oncall: steps I’m going to run now. 1) create temporary forwarder with corrected role-binding, 2) update routing to send lumen-42 to fallback-forwarder-2, 3) if buffers exist, trigger replay.

leo_sre: I’ll prep the IAM/role changes and confirm policy. The root cause looks like a timing gap between role rotation and the forwarder controller update. We need a short-term fix + postmortem action to add healthcheck/lease-refresh alert.

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline queued: forwarder-patch-job -> namespace: lumen-42-forwarder -> image: rw-forwarder:v2.3.1-patch. Build link: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/87421

anna_oncall: applying the k8s manifest to create the temp forwarder (will keep it isolated to lumen-42). Command: ```kubectl apply -f lumen-42-temp-forwarder.yaml -n observability-lumen-42``` Manifest snippet: ```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lw-forwarder-temp
spec:
  replicas: 1
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        tenant: lumen-42
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: forwarder-sa-patched
      containers:
      - name: forwarder
        image: ghcr.io/redwood/forwarder:v2.3.1-patch
```

leo_sre: serviceAccount `forwarder-sa-patched` has the updated assume-role ARNs. After deploy, verify pod logs and `AssumeRole` success. Example check: ```kubectl logs deploy/lw-forwarder-temp -n observability-lumen-42 | grep AssumeRole```

sam_engineer: to mirror traffic to fallback forwarding pool: run: ```curl -X POST "https://router.redwood.internal/mirror" -d '{"tenant":"lumen-42","target":"fallback-forwarder-2","duration_sec":3600}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN'``` Should be non-disruptive.

anna_oncall: mirror started. Confirming new spans appear in fallback forwarder logs. If confirmed, we can mark new telemetry as recovered and then attempt buffered replay for older spans.

leo_sre: checked fallback logs — new spans are arriving at 09:25:12 UTC. Good. Now checking whether forwarder shard retained any buffered batches.

ops-bot: forwarder shard fw-3921 buffer status: 0 batches present (lease expired caused buffer eviction).

sam_engineer: buffer=0 means we can’t replay historical spans. We need to mark historical traces as unrecoverable and update customer messaging accordingly. New traces are being captured going forward.

maria_prod: agreed. Nina, update LumenBank message to say historical traces after 09:11:58 UTC may be unavailable; we’ve restored live tracing and are doing a root-cause analysis. ETA for postmortem: EOD today.

nina_support: posted to LumenBank primary contact + account slack channel. Message pinned in #customer-notify.

anna_oncall: actions for next shift / handoff: 1) Keep mirror for +1h, 2) verify no further AssumeRole failures in forwarder cluster, 3) follow up with infra to audit rotation window and controller refresh logic. I’ll handoff to @maria_prod for incident command.

maria_prod: taking over incident command. Assignments: leo — infra fix for role-binding race; sam — deploy a leader-lease healthmetric for forwarders; anna — keep mirror + validate; nina — customer comms and timeline. We’ll convene a 30-min bridge in 10m to draft the postmortem and timeline for the customer. :thumbsup:

leo_sre: quick mitigation note for postmortem: add a proactive job that verifies role tokens are refreshable 5 minutes prior to expiry and failover-to-patched-SA on detection.

sam_engineer: also recommend adding a per-tenant observability check that asserts span ingestion latency < X and span count weekly baselines to alert earlier.

anna_oncall: leaving a short incident log for the PagerDuty record: "LumenBank dedicated forwarder lease expired -> buffer eviction -> no historical spans; live mirroring to fallback-forwarder restored real-time traces. Customer notified."

incident-bot: Incident update posted to #incidents. Severity: P1 -> mitigated (live capture restored). Postmortem requested by EOD.

maria_prod: handoff complete to @leo_sre for infra fix. Anna, please add any follow-ups to the ticket: https://tracker.redwood.example/INC-7891

anna_oncall: will do. Closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
